# scripts/ops/Export-AvdConfiguration.ps1

<!-- Generated by scripts/Update-BrainDocs.ps1 from the code. Do not edit; edit the code and regenerate. -->

Snapshots the landing zone's configuration that the Bicep doesn't hold, as a recorded run, so a rebuild can put it back (build/specs/recovery-spec.md section 7).
